fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA +11.46%) rose as much as 13.9% in early trading on possible merger with SpaceX and Full Self-Driving V15 software launch, up 12.3% as of 2:18 PM.
fields.summary_ko.1: HSBC analyst Mike Tyndall doubled the target price from $157 to $359; with SpaceX merger $507 (47% upside from Friday), standalone $212 (38% downside).
fields.summary_ko.2: According to Bloomberg, Tesla and SpaceX merger negotiations are ongoing with possible completion by December, and Musk expects robotaxi revenue to become 'notable' by mid-2027.
